content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no exclusivity obligation binds AP.

The Services clause (¶ 1) affirmatively disclaims exclusivity: "Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties." That is stronger than our preferred position, so no redline is needed.

Remaining "exclusive"/"sole" hits are unrelated to restrictive covenants:
- ¶ 2 — non-exclusive license *granted to us* (benefits AP)
- ¶ 64 — exclusive jurisdiction (New York) — governing law, not exclusivity
- ¶ 65 — each Party's trademarks as its exclusive property (mutual)
- ¶ 73 — sole and exclusive benefit of the Parties (third-party beneficiary disclaimer)

Searches for requirements-purchase language, "shall not offer/sell/engage" restrictions, and non-compete terms returned nothing binding AP.
